summary: The quietest week on record: campaign and radar both stayed PAUSED for the entire week, so no `run heat`, `run scenarios`, `run screen`, `run selection`, `run deepdive`, `run redteam`, or `run radar` fired even once, and the funnel produced zero new signals, chains, screens, profiles, or verdicts. The campaign's pause is now roughly 10.6 days past its last real commit (2026-09-15 21:35Z, the BDX red team) with real queued work sitting untouched: ATI-INC, an O1-tier COMPLETE profile on munitions-replenishment, has never had `run deepdive` called on it, and data-center-moratoria and minor-nsr-permits still show an earlier campaign stage (CHAINED) than their own FINAL dives justify, the exact desync last week's digest flagged and nobody has fixed because campaign_calibrate.py has not run since. The one genuine finding of the week came from the market, not the machine: four scenario indicators tripped in the 48 hours before this digest across three unrelated chains (ACM on both data-center-moratoria and minor-nsr-permits, CALM on h5n1-panzootic, GLEN.L on nodule-mining-refining as of today), and ACM matters most because it is the machine's only INVESTABLE call: at $58.52 it now trades below both the $61.04 fifty-two-week low its own entry zone was built on and the zone's own $61.00 floor. Two items resolve rather than worsen last week's open questions: the campaign-board completion worry closed cleanly on 2026-09-21 as a stale-read artifact, not a regression (true state 4/10 themes COMPLETE, 19/20 O1 FINAL), and check_model.py's violation count fell from 122 to 33 purely because its 21-day window rolled past the early-September burst, not because anything ran on the correct tier this week (nothing ran at all). The backlog grew from 77 to 80 open rows, all housekeeping.

ranked.title: ACM, the machine's only INVESTABLE call, now trades below the 52-week low its own entry zone was built on
ranked.case: ACM's entry zone (data/stocks/ACM__data-center-moratoria.json) set its $61.00 floor explicitly at the price where a reverse-DCF bisection asks for zero real FCF growth in perpetuity, a level the dive noted "essentially coincides with the stock's own 52-week low print of $61.04 on 2026-08-12." As of 2026-09-24, data/indicators.json shows AECOM closing at $58.52, tripping two independent scenario indicators the same day: data-center-moratoria's S5 ("AECOM prints below its 52 week low... where a collapse in mandated study volume would show up first," level <61.04) and minor-nsr-permits' own S5 ("AECOM falls to 62 or below... confirming the consultancy de-rating is the tier and not one name," level <=62). The price is now below both the trip levels and the entry zone's own $61.00 floor, with no_entry_above at $75.00 untouched. Nothing in the file has been re-run to say whether this is a cheaper entry into a thesis that still holds or the first evidence the thesis itself is wrong; that read is exactly what these two indicators exist to force.

ranked.title: Three unrelated chains posted fresh breakdown signals in the same 48 hours
ranked.case: Beyond ACM (above), two more indicators tripped in this same window and both read the same way: continuation of an existing de-rating, not a new one. CALM (h5n1-panzootic S3) closed at $68.48 on 2026-09-24, through the $72.44 trip level the card describes as "confirming that the de-rating this chain's own prior heat run flagged as its most surprising finding continues rather than reverses." GLEN.L (nodule-mining-refining S2) closed at $549.00 on 2026-09-26, today, through $550.00, described as "consistent with a market discounting the pace of any non-Chinese supply diversification this pathway offers" on the NORI nickel-copper offtake exposure. None of the three chains behind these tickers has a FINAL dive, so no shadow row exists yet and none of this changes a verdict; it is a pattern worth carrying into whichever of these three gets chained or screened next.
